items.item: The default-value fallback is exercised on a genuinely v2-format table (format_version == 2, asserted directly), not a v3 table, making this a real instance of a widely used v2 implementation running ahead of the spec's own version boundary -- disclosed plainly in FACT-CHECK.md red-team #2.

items.item: Both the old-row-gets-default and new-row-keeps-its-own-value halves of the fallback are asserted by exact row-list comparison, not just 'it ran with no error'.

The Databricks three-feature list is the vendor's own complete summary sentence, not a cherry-picked subset -- the other five v3 features' absence from that announcement is reported as an absence in a point-in-time snapshot, not as permanent non-support, per FACT-CHECK.md red-team #3.
